change: Add only literal surface 'center-data' to the whitelist. Eligibility itself does not accept a resource failure.

before.countSource: Individual test result lines; baseline failure is the new positive center-data case.

newCoverage: Exact existing stale BTC request is eligible in center-data.
data, center-data-eth and center-data-frame remain ineligible.
ETH URL, duplicate query key, HTTP503 response event, POST, Script resource type, other blocking reason, missing frame/loader/request IDs and invalid request clock remain ineligible.

checks: All3 new routes select BTCUSD daily line chart.
Initial callback follows parent outlook/no center assertions.
The child comparison frame is matched by parent ID and URL; no offline refresh callback is invoked in the child.
Return requires center removal and unchanged parent timeOrigin/price/date/kind/cutoff/product.
Return verification requires initial validation and an explicit native parent retry creating a distinct request.
remainingGuards: Exact current document URL binds one frame and loader.
Failed-refresh UI, visible enabled retry, live announcement, retained cutoff and displayed actual BTC price/date/kind must agree.
Exactly one new request ID must match that frame/loader and the precise stale BTC CoinMetrics query.
All other resource errors remain unexpected failures.

limits: Policy unit verification and caller source review only; native center-data cases are executed by the performance/integration owner.
Historical preview and indicator receipts retain the policy hash measured in those runs.
No production URL, source data, price, immutable forecast, mathematics, ETH error classification or model promotion was changed.
